what: PR 1497's next/ law-option work belongs to tracker ticket 1140. Historical run rows saying ticket 580 confused decision 0580 with a tracker number. Tracker ticket 580 is unrelated. The assigned audit created ticket 1140 and independently read back its title, body and PR source before this build continued.

fix: Use verified ticket 1140 for current work. Keep historical ticket fields as written. The signed plan permits only the separate removal of one unmerged stale plant record.
